name: interviewmate-ai
description: InterviewMate AI - AI-powered mock interview practice with Google Gemini

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
